title: Lumina Digital Mall
shortDescription: A hyper-fluid commerce platform engineered for luxury retail.
tagline: A hyper-fluid architectural commerce platform designed for the next generation of luxury retail engineering.
challenge: Traditional retail applications suffer from rigid data structures that fail to capture the rhythmic flow of architectural aesthetics. Lumina required a system that could handle 10,000+ SKU updates per minute without compromising on the silky 120Hz micro-interactions expected by luxury consumers.
solution: We engineered a bespoke reactive state-management architecture using Flutter and a high-concurrency Firebase backend. By implementing custom shader-based transitions and a geometry-focused design system, we achieved a 45% increase in session duration.

title: Nova Real Estate VR
shortDescription: Immersive 3D property tours built for the next generation of homebuyers.
tagline: An immersive virtual property exploration suite blending architectural visualization with real-time 3D rendering.
challenge: Buyers could not get a true sense of scale or light from static photography alone, and existing 3D viewers were too heavy for mobile devices to render smoothly.
solution: We built a lightweight custom 3D rendering pipeline on top of Flutter's GPU-accelerated canvas, streaming optimized mesh data on demand to keep load times under a second even on mid-range devices.

title: Aether Boutique
shortDescription: A boutique fashion storefront with editorial-grade product presentation.
tagline: A refined fashion commerce experience that treats every product page like an editorial spread.
challenge: The client's existing app felt generic and templated, undermining a brand built on exclusivity and craft.
solution: We designed a fully custom UI kit with hand-tuned typography and motion, paired with a headless commerce backend for full content flexibility.

title: Vitalis AI
shortDescription: AI-assisted health monitoring with real-time biometric visualization.
tagline: An AI-driven wellness companion that turns raw biometric streams into clear, actionable insight.
challenge: Raw sensor data from wearables was accurate but unreadable to everyday users, and on-device inference needed to run without draining battery life.
solution: We integrated a quantized on-device ML model for real-time anomaly detection, paired with a custom data-visualization layer built natively in Flutter.

title: Estate Logic
shortDescription: Portfolio management tooling for real estate investment firms.
tagline: A precision financial dashboard for real estate investors tracking portfolios across multiple markets.
challenge: Investors were juggling spreadsheets across multiple properties with no single source of truth for portfolio performance.
solution: We built a unified dashboard with live market data integration and automated reporting, replacing manual spreadsheet workflows entirely.

title: Sonic Pure
shortDescription: An ear-training and music theory app for self-taught musicians.
tagline: A gamified ear-training platform that makes music theory click through daily bite-sized practice.
challenge: Existing ear-training apps felt like homework. The client wanted something that felt more like a game you would actually want to open every day.
solution: We designed a streak-based progression system with adaptive difficulty, paired with real-time audio pitch detection built using Flutter low-latency audio plugins.
